title: aruncus dioicus var. subrotundatus
intro: Aruncus dioicus var. subrotundatus, commonly known as the dwarf gothic goat's beard or dwarf goatsbeard, is a plant species in the buckwheat family (Polygonaceae). The health benefits of Aruncus dioicus var. subrotundatus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aruncus dioicus var. subrotundatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
